title: Tim Taylor shows up with experiencers Bledsoe and Charles Hall

tellings.quote: He showed up in the life of Chris Bledsoe. He showed up with Charles Hall who said that he lived with aliens at Area 51.

plain: Michels says that a man named Timothy Taylor keeps turning up in the lives of people who report contact with nonhuman beings. He names Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had such encounters, and Charles Hall, who says he lived with aliens at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a pattern that seems to tie Taylor to these cases.
